why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: Open globemarkets.xyz and scroll to the early access form.
Enter your email, then "Enter the 6-digit code we sent to" your inbox. No wallet is needed.
Connect X to reserve your handle and get 25 points.
Follow @globemkts on X and join the Telegram for 10 points each.
Share your personal link if you want to climb the list. Each friend who joins is worth 50 points.
Stay on the list until 30 November for the badge, then watch for your access invite.
costs: The waitlist is free and needs only an email: "We'll only email you about your Globe access." Trading after launch will need a deposit: "Deposit any asset from any chain into Globe and start trading." Globe hasn't published its fees. The fee in its mockups is an example, not a rate.
